At the JFTC's Competition Policy Research Center (CPRC), I reported on the progress of my research at an interim report workshop. I received a great many valuable comments, not only from legal scholars but also from economists. What remains is to complete it as a discussion paper, and I will do my best to finish writing within the fiscal year if I can.
